blocks.tamil_translation: I do not ask of you any reward for this; my reward is only with the Lord of the worlds (and with no one else)”.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَمآ آتَيْتُمْ مِنْ زَكوةٍ تُرِيْدُوْنَ وَجْهَ اللهِ فَاُولئِكَ هُمُ الْمُضْعِفُوْنَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: What you give of Zakat seeking the Countenance (the pleasure) of Allah (it will multiply with Allah); it is they who multiply (their rewards).
Call upon Him alone, making this Deen sincerely (pure) for Him alone.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (لَنْ يَنَالَ اللهَ لُحُوْمُهَا وَلَا دِمآؤُهَا وَلكِنْ يَنَالُهُ التَّقْوَي مِنْكُمْ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Neither their flesh nor their blood (of the sacrificial animals) ever reaches Allah; but it is the taqwa (fear of Allah) in you that reaches Him.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: اِنَّ اللهَ لَا يَنْظُرُ اِلَي صُوَرِكُمْ وَاَمْوَالِكُمْ، وَلكِنْ يَنْظُرُ اِلَي قُلُوْبِكُمْ وَاَعْمَالِكُمْ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب تحريم ظلم المسلم...، رقم:٦٥٤٣
blocks.tamil_translation: “Indeed, Allah Ta'ala does not look at your forms or your wealth,
